findings.rationale: The aws_iam_role.admin trust statement makes the role assumable and its aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.admin attachment grants AdministratorAccess, allowing an assumed identity to exercise full account administration.

The aws_iam_policy.assume_broadly Statement[0] permits sts:AssumeRole against every role, giving its attached principal account-wide role-assumption authority instead of access only to designated roles.

The aws_iam_role.external_trust Statement[0].Principal identifies a principal outside the owning AWS account, permitting an external identity to assume the role and cross the account identity boundary.

findings.control: identity boundary: MFA condition on sensitive trust
findings.rationale: The aws_iam_role.external_trust Statement[0] contains no MFA Condition, so the trusted external principal can assume the sensitive role without proving possession of a multi-factor device.
